# MOV_0581.mp4 + MOV_0581.nmea

## Source

- **URL**: https://www.mediafire.com/file/czc96j7tqkgangt/samplefiles.zip
  (inside the archive - the `samplefiles/` folder).
- **Where it was posted**: [DashCamTalk thread "Dashcam video samples and other informations"](https://dashcamtalk.com/forum/threads/dashcam-video-samples-and-other-informations.32662/),
  user `Minimanu`, 2018-01-16. The sample was provided as a test set for
  checking the **Dashcam Viewer** app by Earthshine Software.
- **Date obtained**: 2026-05-01.
- **License**: no explicit permissions; a forum attachment posted
  publicly for technical testing purposes. Used under "fair use for
  technical discussion" - the standard convention for forum sample files.

## What's inside

- Original recording from 2013-01-29, ~54 seconds, Sydney AU region
  (lat ~-34, lon ~151). GPS sample rate 1Hz + G-sensor 1Hz.
- Format: NMEA sidecar `*.nmea` next to the MP4 (matched by basename), no
  line prefix. Contains alternating `$GPRMC` (GPS) and `$GSENSOR,X,Y,Z`
  (custom accelerometer) sentences.
- Video container is QuickTime (`.MOV`), not MP4. Codec H.264, ~1280x720.

## Vendor identification

The exact model/vendor cannot be determined from the file alone. The name
`MOV_0581` is a generic counter pattern, not matching known dashcam
conventions (VIOFO `YYYY_MMDD_...`, BlackVue `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_...`, 70mai
`NO...`). The custom `$GSENSOR` extension in the NMEA is typical of Mio
MiVue/Vicovation/DOD, but the exact model cannot be confirmed without
metadata.

In our `parsers/nmea-sidecar.ts` plugin, this file is picked up via the
`nmeaSidecar` handler (matching by basename `*.nmea` + `*.mov` ->
generic-vendor video).

## Anonymization

- `MOV_0581.nmea` anonymized via `scripts/anonymize-nmea-log.mjs`:
  coordinates rounded to whole degrees (`3400.0000,S` = -34° lat,
  precision ~110 km), `$GSENSOR` left as-is, timestamps not shifted,
  ~60 lines.
- `MOV_0581.mp4` anonymized via `scripts/anonymize-mp4.mjs`:
  ffmpeg testsrc2 + 1kHz sine -20dB, duration 2 sec, H.264 at the same
  resolution as the original (~1280x720). Contains no frame of the
  original recording; audio replaced with a test signal. Container is MP4
  (not the original MOV).

## Use in tests

Covers the real-world generic-NMEA-sidecar scenario: ingest MP4 + a
matching basename `*.nmea` next to it -> picked up via `nmeaSidecar`,
parsed via `parseNmeaText`, yielding `GpsRecord[]`. Test in
`nmea-sidecar.test.ts`.
